files.label: Game app
files.summary: The Mac app MacNativeGames built for Octopath Traveler 0.
files.detail: Play opens this app. It's named Octopath Traveler 0.app, and MacNativeGames puts it next to your game file unless you chose another folder when building (for example ~/Games/macOS). The app carries the game's files; Graft puts your mods in the game's mod folder in ~/Library/Application Support/MacNativeGames/OT0.

files.label: Work folder
files.summary: The folder MacNativeGames worked in when it built the game app.
files.detail: It's usually OT0_build inside games/ot0 in your MacNativeGames folder. Graft uses the Python that the build set up there to prepare your mods for the game.
